message: 有言の威圧

name: Synn
message: 「I feel so weighed down...」
A complaint slips out of my mouth before I can stop it.
Day one of exams is over. Even though I did my best, I simply started studying way too late.
If my grades drop, I'll have brought it on myself, though the Crusaders' activities are different in nature from a regular club.

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't tell me you're plannin' to petition Helena and beg for the chairwoman's mercy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh...! I know it's wishful thinking.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, there's a one-in-a-million chance, maybe, just maybe, that Helena-san might show some understanding.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Too sweet. Not just sugar-sweet, you're talkin' saccharin levels of naive. Take a look over there?」
The door to the chairwoman's office is slightly ajar. As if to say: Go on, peek! Come on, check out what's going on inside!

name: Synn
message: 「V-veeeery quietly.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, Synn-chan! ...And so says Helena, greeting nobody in particular.\s04」
I nearly let out a cry of shock, but desperately hold it back.
For some reason, Helena-san is standing squarely in front of the door like a guardian statue. In her right hand is a hobby knife, and in her left is a piece of metal.

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, making trophies really is such hard work. After all, the material costs can't be written off as academy operating expenses.」
T-those trophies were handmade by Helena-san!?

name: Helena
message: 「Hee-hee-hee♪ Still, those kids are working so hard on their exams. I simply have to give them a reward.\s07」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see, I'll need four--for Synn-chan, Nanaka-chan, Misa-chan, and Lolotte-chan? Third-years don't have exams, so Ria's trophy is on hold.」
Um... hasn't she been reading in a total monotone this whole time?

name: Helena
message: 「While borrowing the power of the guardian angels to exterminate demons, Ria has achieved truly exemplary grades in her academics.」

name: Helena
message: 「And I, as the previous Crusader, was the exact same.」
Is it just my imagination? Helena-san's words sound awfully expository.

name: Helena
message: 「Ho-ho-ho-ho, and now, as Commander, I dedicate myself to crafting trophies. Diligently chiseling away just like this.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm, I wonder if Synn-chan and the other three will be alright on their midterms this time?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, worrying about something like this is completely unnecessary.」

name: Helena
message: 「After all, there's no way my juniors would neglect their primary duty as students--studying--just because Re-Crea is approaching.」
H-Helena-san... your tone went completely flat again, you know?

name: Helena
message: 「Surely nobody would say something like, 'I was so busy with Crusaders that I didn't have time to study,' or--」
Gulp!?

name: Helena
message: 「'I'm a Student Council officer, so please give me special treatment even if I get bad test scores'--」
Flinch, flinch!!

name: Helena
message: 「If there were a kid making excuses like that, the Chairwoman would find it so pathetic she'd just start crying, okay?」

name: Helena
message: 「Though, I do wonder who on earth I'm even talking to right now?」
I-It's me, isn't it?

name: Synn
message: 「...It's not too late to start now. I'll do my absolute best on the tests.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ya shoulda done that from the start!」
Given a push by Helena-san and Paqy, I steel my resolve to study.
When I reached the entrance of the old school building and happened to glance back down the hallway, I saw Lolotte peeking into the Chairwoman's office this time.
